risks.description: E5 3.16M parameter model trained from scratch on 1,670 instruction records (855k tokens) achieves only 0/24 raw CAP pass rate due to undertraining and lack of foundation pretraining tokens.
risks.remediation: Build a 50M+ token multilingual foundation pretraining corpus before instruction fine-tuning.

risks.description: InferenceRuntimeService defaults to raw greedy decoding unless theta=1.25 and 3-gram parameters are explicitly injected in GenerationConfig.
risks.remediation: Update default GenerationConfig in backend/services/inference_runtime_service.py to theta=1.25.

risks.description: 71 duplicate class names across 216 occurrences increase maintenance cognitive load.
risks.remediation: Maintain containment matrix; archive versioned phase snapshots post-release.
